study.notes: STUDY: single centre randomised placebo controlled single blind (patient) trial (Buffalo) in obese insulin treated type 2 diabetes with HbA1c 7.5 to 9 percent: exenatide 10 ug twice daily (dose_mg 0.01 per injection) vs placebo for 12 weeks (the eligibility minimum), 12 per arm; Table 1 gives baseline and 12 week values per arm as mean plus or minus SE (route arm_change_imputed_r_sem, brief amendment A8, correlation 0.5; the superscript a marks paired t tests vs baseline, not used); the inflammatory indices (ROS, NF kappa B, MCP-1, MMP-9, SAA, IL-6) are the stated aim, IL-6 is given for the exenatide arm only (no placebo values printed) and is not entered; body weight in pounds unchanged (251 to 251 lbs exenatide), pct_weight_change empty; NIH and ADA grants to the senior author, no industry role stated (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall some_concerns

rows.notes: Table 1: HbA1c percent baseline and 12 weeks per arm, SE as printed (n 12 per arm)
Table 1: fasting glucose mg/dL, SE as printed
Table 1: fasting insulin uU/mL, SE as printed; all patients on insulin therapy, the rise with exenatide is as printed

json.design: single centre randomised placebo controlled single blind trial, exenatide 10 ug twice daily vs placebo, obese insulin treated type 2 diabetes, 24 randomised (12 per arm), 12 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); five inventory markers from Table 1 (mean plus or minus SE per arm, amendment A8 route); IL-6 and the other inflammatory indices are given for the exenatide arm only
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: IL6 (exenatide arm only: 3.01 plus or minus 0.49 to 2.07 plus or minus 0.57 pg/mL at 12 weeks, minus 22 plus or minus 12 percent, P below 0.05; placebo stated as no change, no values)
TNF_alpha (mRNA expression in mononuclear cells only, no plasma value)
other_markers: mononuclear cell ROS generation, NF kappa B binding, JNK-1, TLR-2, TLR-4, SOCS-3 expression

rob.justification: randomised without a described sequence or concealment (D1 some concerns); patient blinded only (D2 some concerns); 12 per arm analysed throughout as reported (D3 low); laboratory assays (D4 low); no registration cited, markers named in the aims (D5 some concerns)

doubts: Table 1 prints SE with n 12 per arm; rows declared arm_change_imputed_r_sem
